plan: Psalm 61:1-8; Psalm 62:1-12; Psalm 64:1-10; Psalm 65:1-13; Psalm 66:1-20; Psalm 67:1-7

readings.title: Lead Me to the Rock
readings.subtitle: A Prayer from the Ends of the Earth
readings.text:
[Psalm 61:1] Hear my cry, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, Listen to my prayer.
[2] From the end of the earth I call unto <dn>You</dn>, When my heart is faint; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
[3] For <dn>You</dn> have been my refuge, A strong tower in the face of the enemy.
[4] Let me dwell in <dn>Your</dn> Tent forever, Let me take refuge in the shelter of <dn>Your</dn> wings. Selah.
[5] For <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, have heard my vows; <dn>You</dn> have given me the inheritance Of those who fear <dn>Your</dn> Name.
[6] <dn>You</dn> add days to the days of the sovereign, His years as many generations.
[7] Let him dwell forever before <dn>Elohim</dn>. Prepare loving-commitment and truth to preserve him!
[8] So I sing praise to <dn>Your</dn> Name forever, When I pay my vows day by day.

readings.title: Rest in Elohim Alone
readings.subtitle: Trusting the True Rock
readings.text:
[Psalm 62:1] My being finds rest in <dn>Elohim</dn> alone; From <dn>Him</dn> is my deliverance.
[2] <dn>He</dn> alone is my rock and my deliverance, my strong tower; I am not greatly shaken.
[3] How long would you shout at a man? – Murder! – Like a leaning wall, a tottering fence.
[4] They plotted to topple him from his high position; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, But in their heart they curse. Selah.
[5] My being, find rest in <dn>Elohim</dn> alone, Because my expectation is from <dn>Him</dn>.
[6] <dn>He</dn> alone is my rock and my deliverance, my strong tower; I am not shaken.
[7] My deliverance and my esteem depend on <dn>Elohim</dn>; The rock of my strength, my refuge is in <dn>Elohim</dn>.
[8] Trust in <dn>Him</dn> at all times, you people; Pour out your heart before <dn>Him</dn>; <dn>Elohim</dn> is a refuge for us. Selah.
[9] Sons of Aḏam are but a breath, Sons of men are a lie; If weighed in the scales, They are altogether lighter than breath.
[10] Do not trust in oppression. And do not become vain in robbery; If riches increase, Do not set your heart on them.
[11] <dn>Elohim</dn> has spoken once, Twice I have heard this: That strength belongs to <dn>Elohim</dn>.
[12] And loving-commitment is <dn>Yours</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; For <dn>You</dn> reward each one according to his work.

readings.title: Protection from Secret Plots
readings.subtitle: The Sudden Arrow of Justice
readings.text:
[Psalm 64:1] Hear my voice, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, in my meditation; Guard my life from the threats of the enemy.
[2] Hide me from the secret plans of the evil-doers, From the tumult of the workers of wickedness,
[3] Who sharpen their tongue like a sword, And aim their arrows, a bitter word,
[4] To shoot in ambush at someone blameless, They shoot at him suddenly and do not fear.
[5] They arm themselves with an evil word; They talk of hiding snares; They have said, “Who sees them?”
[6] They search out unrighteousnesses, “We have perfected a well searched out plan.” For the inward part of man, and heart, are deep.
[7] But <dn>Elohim</dn> does shoot at them with an arrow; Their wounds shall be sudden.
[8] And they cause one to stumble, Their own tongue is against them; All who see them flee away.
[9] And all men fear, And declare the work of <dn>Elohim</dn>. And they shall wisely consider What <dn>He</dn> has done.
[10] The righteous rejoice in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And shall take refuge in <dn>Him</dn>, And all the upright in heart praise <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: The Crown of Goodness
readings.subtitle: Praise for the Creator's Provision
readings.text:
[Psalm 65:1] To <dn>You</dn>, stillness, praise, in Tsiyon, O <dn>Elohim</dn>; And to <dn>You</dn> a vow is paid.
[2] To <dn>You</dn> who hears all prayer, all flesh comes.
[3] Crooked matters were mightier than I; As for our transgressions, <dn>You</dn> do cover them.
[4] Blessed is the one <dn>You</dn> choose, And bring near to dwell in <dn>Your</dn> courts. We are satisfied with the goodness of <dn>Your</dn> house, <dn>Your</dn> set-apart Hěḵal.
[5] By awesome deeds in righteousness <dn>You</dn> answer us, O <dn>Elohim</dn> of our deliverance, The Trust of all the ends of the earth, And the distant seas;
[6] Who established the mountains by <dn>His</dn> strength, Being girded with might;
[7] Who stills the roaring of the seas, The roaring of their waves, And the uproar of the peoples.
[8] And they who dwell in the farthest parts, Are afraid of <dn>Your</dn> signs; <dn>You</dn> make the outgoings of the morning and evening rejoice.
[9] <dn>You</dn> have visited the earth and watered it, <dn>You</dn> greatly enrich it; The river of <dn>Elohim</dn> is filled with water; <dn>You</dn> provide their grain, For so <dn>You</dn> have prepared it.
[10] Its ridges have been filled, Its furrows have been deepened, <dn>You</dn> make it soft with showers, <dn>You</dn> bless its growth.
[11] <dn>You</dn> have crowned the year with <dn>Your</dn> goodness, And <dn>Your</dn> paths drip with fatness.
[12] The pastures of the wilderness drip, And the hills are girded with rejoicing.
[13] The meadows are dressed in flocks, And valleys are covered with grain; They shout for joy and sing.

readings.title: Awesome Acts Toward Men
readings.subtitle: Refined in the Fire
readings.text:
[Psalm 66:1] Shout with joy to <dn>Elohim</dn>, All the earth!
[2] Sing out the splendour of <dn>His</dn> Name; Make <dn>His</dn> praise esteemed.
[3] Say to <dn>Elohim</dn>, “How awesome are <dn>Your</dn> works! Through the greatness of <dn>Your</dn> power <dn>Your</dn> enemies pretend obedience to <dn>You</dn>.
[4] “All the earth bow to <dn>You</dn>, They sing praises to <dn>You</dn>, They praise <dn>Your</dn> Name.” Selah.
[5] Come and see the works of <dn>Elohim</dn>, Awesome acts toward the sons of men.
[6] <dn>He</dn> has turned the sea into dry land, They went through the river on foot. There we rejoiced in <dn>Him</dn>,
[7] Who rules by <dn>His</dn> power forever; <dn>His</dn> eyes keeping watch on the nations; Let the rebellious not exalt themselves. Selah.
[8] Bless our <dn>Elohim</dn>, you peoples! And sound <dn>His</dn> praise abroad,
[9] Who keeps us in life, And does not allow our feet to be moved.
[10] For <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, have proved us; <dn>You</dn> have refined us as silver is refined.
[11] <dn>You</dn> brought us into the net; <dn>You</dn> laid affliction on our loins.
[12] <dn>You</dn> have let men ride at our head; We went through fire and through water; But <dn>You</dn> brought us out to plenty.

readings.title: Fulfilling Vows in the House
readings.subtitle: The Voice of Prayer Heard
readings.text:
[Psalm 66:13] I enter <dn>Your</dn> house with ascending offerings; I complete my vows to <dn>You</dn>,
[14] That which my lips have uttered And my mouth spoke in my distress.
[15] Ascending offerings of fatlings I offer to <dn>You</dn>, With the incense of rams; I offer bulls with goats. Selah.
[16] Come, hear, all you who fear <dn>Elohim</dn>, And I relate what <dn>He</dn> has done for my being.
[17] I called to <dn>Him</dn> with my mouth, And praise was in my tongue.
[18] If I have seen wickedness in my heart, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> would not hear.
[19] Truly, <dn>Elohim</dn> has heard me; <dn>He</dn> has given heed to the voice of my prayer.
[20] Blessed be <dn>Elohim</dn>, Who has not turned away my prayer, Nor <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment from me!

readings.title: Let the Nations Be Glad
readings.subtitle: A Blessing for All the Earth
readings.text:
[Psalm 67:1] <dn>Elohim</dn> does favour us and bless us, Cause <dn>His</dn> face to shine upon <dn>את</dn> us. Selah.
[2] For <dn>Your</dn> way to be known on earth, <dn>Your</dn> deliverance among all nations.
[3] Let the peoples praise <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, Let all the peoples praise <dn>You</dn>.
[4] Let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For <dn>You</dn> judge the peoples uprightly, And lead the nations on earth. Selah.
[5] Let the peoples praise <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>Elohim</dn>; Let all the peoples praise <dn>You</dn>.
[6] The earth shall give her increase; <dn>Elohim</dn>, our own <dn>Elohim</dn>, blesses us!
[7] <dn>Elohim</dn> blesses us! And all the ends of the earth fear <dn>את</dn> <dn>Him</dn>!
